3. INSPECT CENTER SUPPORT BEARING
Check that the bearing turns freely.
If the bearing is damaged, worn, or does not turn freely,
replace it.

REPLACEMENT OF SPIDER BEARING

1. PLACE MATCHMARKS ON SHAFT AND FLANGE OR
YOKE

2. REMOVE SNAP RINGS
(a) Slightly tap in the bearing outer races.
(b) Using two screwdrivers, remove the four snap rings
from the grooves.
